description.en: AgentREVEAL is a diagnostic framework that evaluates safety alignment degradation in LLM agents when web retrieval is integrated. It assesses the impact of retrieval integration and content properties on harmful compliance, using a set of harmful behaviors and retrieval sources.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: AgentREVEAL addresses the underexplored risk that safety-aligned LLMs become more compliant with harmful requests when augmented with web retrieval. Its findings highlight a safety-utility trade-off that informs the design of safer retrieval-enabled agents.
